Metadata.title: GoToUSA
Metadata.description: Your companion on the journey to prepare for living in the United States.

Welcome.eyebrow: Your journey to the United States
Welcome.title: Moving to another country is a journey. Let's walk it together.
Welcome.intro: Visas, money and housing matter, but they are only part of the path. Preparation comes first: language, culture, finances, family and the right place for you. GoToUSA helps you see the whole picture and follow your progress, step by step.

you.title: You lead the journey
you.body: GoToUSA is your guide: it shows the tasks, explains, reminds and celebrates with you. But you are always the one who decides and acts.

whole.title: See the whole path
whole.body: It is a long journey, with effort and trade-offs. Seeing everything organized from the start helps you keep going when things get hard.

decide.title: Deciding is also a win
decide.body: If along the way you realize it is not for you, that is okay. What matters is making a conscious decision, for the right reasons.

data.title: Your data stays with you
data.body: Your answers are saved only in this browser. Clearing the browser deletes everything, but you will be able to download your journey to keep it.

Disclaimer.title: Important notice
Disclaimer.body1: GoToUSA supports your journey. It is not a legal service and does not provide legal advice.
Disclaimer.body2: The information shown is compiled from official U.S. sources, but mistakes can happen when summarizing. Each piece of content links to the full official source.
Disclaimer.body3: For decisions about your situation, always check the official source or talk to an immigration attorney or a specialist.
Disclaimer.checkbox: I have read and understand that GoToUSA is not a legal service.

Questionnaire.title: Questionnaire
Questionnaire.intro: Answer at your own pace. With the essential part (about 10 minutes), the first version of your journey can already be built. The other sections make your journey more precise.
